blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — While it is easy to conclude that the recent Social Weather Stations (SWS) survey indicated that the prosecution is losing in the court of public opinion, a panel member has stressed that it also showed a huge clamor for Vice President Sara Duterte to explain herself before the impeachment court. In an online interview on Friday, counsel for the prosecution Benjamin Tolosa Jr. highlighted that the SWS survey also showed that 78 percent of the respondents interviewed from September 21 to 27 said it is important for Duterte to testify personally, in the face of serious allegations against her.
